user.title: Set up LIBI
user.description: LIBI adds a ladder logic editor for your automations to the sidebar. Choose whether its AI chat may use an AI model.

local.title: Local AI
local.description: The address and model of a local LLM server, for example Ollama. When you use the AI Chat, your request, the names of the devices you pick and, while sharing is on, the nets open in the LIBI page and your helpers are sent to this server, and stay in your network as long as the server does.

cloud.title: Cloud AI
cloud.description: A cloud AI service that offers the OpenAI chat completions API: Google Gemini, OpenAI, or another compatible service. When you use the AI Chat, your request and the names of the devices you pick are sent to this service. While "Share the nets on this page and my helpers" is on (in the chat), so are the nets open in the LIBI page, your helpers, and the devices that match the request with their state. Your other automations and the rest of your devices are never sent.

data_description.cloud_base_url: Only for Other. Leave empty for Gemini and OpenAI.

error.cannot_connect: LIBI could not reach the AI server. Check the address and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: The AI service rejected the API key.
error.model_not_found: The AI server does not have this model. Check the model name.

abort.single_instance_allowed: LIBI is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.
